stories.title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is making a new smart speaker device (like an Amazon Alexa device) that will cost between $300 and $400.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're interested in AI assistants for your home or shop, this is another option to consider, but it's fairly expensive.

stories.title: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is working with a famous designer from Apple to make a small, round smart speaker about the size of a hockey puck, coming out in 2027 for over $300.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a future product — nothing to act on yet, but if you want a voice-controlled AI device, you'll have more choices soon.

stories.title: This A.I. Just Created Viruses Not Found in Nature
stories.simple_summary: Scientists used AI to design new viruses that don't exist in nature.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious safety concern for experts and governments — nothing directly affecting your daily life, but something scientists are worried about.

stories.title: Safety fears as scientists make first viruses designed by AI
stories.simple_summary: Scientists are using AI to create brand new viruses, which raises safety worries.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important to government and health authorities — not something an ordinary person needs to worry about right now.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence used to design brand new viruses
stories.simple_summary: Artificial intelligence has been used to design completely new viruses that never existed before.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a safety issue experts are concerned about — doesn't affect you directly, but it's something regulators need to monitor.

stories.title: Suno shares plans to combat spammy AI music
stories.simple_summary: Suno, an AI music company, is adding watermarks (hidden labels) to music and new rules so people can't just copy and spread AI-made songs carelessly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use or create music, this means AI-made songs will be marked clearly — helping protect real musicians and making things more honest.

stories.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is letting free users of ChatGPT (their AI chatbot) have as many text conversations as they want, plus a new button to help with hard questions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT for free, you can now use it more without hitting limits — good if you need help with research or questions.

stories.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
stories.simple_summary: A company called Naïve raised money ($28.5 million) to build software that automates the boring paperwork and setup work needed to start and run a business.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and other companies — it's too new to know if it will actually work for small business owners yet.

stories.title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is removing the limit on how many times free ChatGPT users can chat with the AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use free ChatGPT, you can now use it as much as you want without the system saying you've reached your limit.

stories.title: Control agent behaviors and cost beyond a single action: new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
stories.simple_summary: Amazon announced new features for Bedrock, a tool that companies use to build their own AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical news for engineers and tech companies — nothing you need to know about as a small business owner.

stories.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
stories.simple_summary: New dating apps for younger people are replacing the simple left/right swipe system with AI that tries to match people more intelligently.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're interested in dating apps or have young adult children, there are new options that work differently than the old Tinder-style apps.

stories.title: OpenAI says Apple’s own security practices undermine its trade secrets case
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is arguing in court that Apple's own weak security practices mean Apple's lawsuit against them about stolen secrets isn't valid.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal battle between two big companies — mostly interesting to investors and lawyers, not something affecting ordinary people.
